title: Prop 15.261 exact Max± config multiplicities; Q-match ⇔ ν=0; residual (i) OPEN

mult_formula.theorem: mult_+(α)=(N/16)(1+qf(α)/(2p)+pr(α)m₄⁺(S)) and mult_-(α)=(N/16)(1−qf(α)/(2p)+pr(α)m₄⁻(S)), for any 4-set S, under odd-moment vanishing and π=±C/p.

nonneg_bound.theorem: mult±≥0 ⇒ linear inequalities on m₄±.  If q_max=max|αᵀAα| and both signs appear for both products, |m₄±|≤1−q_max/(2p).  On |κ|=1, q_max≤8 ⇒ |m₄±|≤1−4/p, which is >1/(2p) for p≥5.

orientation_eq.theorem: On |κ|=1 with QᵀAQ=−A, det D=+1: mult_+(α)=mult_-(Qᵀα) ∀α  ⇔  ν(S)=0.  Proof: plug mult formulas and qf(Qᵀα)=−qf(α).  Either side OPEN as a general statement (census both true p=5,7).

hinge.open: mult formula proved; Q-match ⇔ ν=0 on |κ|=1; still need ν=0 or reflection or tighter L^∞ bound Max+-free.

F3: Exact mult_±(α)=(N/16)(1±qf/(2p)+pr m₄±) proved Max+-free.  On |κ|=1, Q-config-match ⇔ ν=0.  Bound 1−4/p too weak for 1/(2p).  Residual-(i) still OPEN.  No predicate flip.
